messages:
omar_ae: Hey team, I'm Omar (AE) starting today. I'm blocked on two things: 1) Salesforce tenant access (SSO errors), and 2) getting demo environment credentials for the product demo VM. Who do I ping?

jules-ops: Welcome Omar! Tagging IT. Did you fill the app request in the onboarding checklist? That usually triggers both Salesforce and demo access.

omar_ae: I completed the checklist but I may have missed the checkbox for 'demo environment'. Sales collateral link worked though. Salesforce SSO redirects to IdP with 'insufficient permissions'.

jules-ops: Thanks. @it-bot please create ticket for Salesforce SSO + Demo VM access for omar_ae, role=AE. Also please add Omar to #sales-demos and share the demo login steps.

it-bot: Ticket created: IT-2750 - "Provision: omar_ae  Salesforce SSO + Demo VM access". ETA 3 business hours. Link: https://tickets.redwood.internal/IT-2750

marta_cs: hey Omar, welcome! For demos we have two modes: sandbox with full feature flags (internal only) and a scripted demo VM for customer-facing calls. If you want to shadow a demo, ping me and I can add you to my calendar. Also the demo scripts are in the playbook drive.

omar_ae: Awesome, would love to shadow. Also quick Q: do we have a shortened one-pager for enterprise buyers that focuses on privacy/compliance? Trying to tailor my outreach.

playbooks-bot: Enterprise one-pager available: https://redwood.example.com/sales/playbooks/enterprise-privacy-onepager (internal). Added omar_ae to drive folder '/sales/playbooks/enterprise'.

it-bot: IT-2750 update: Salesforce group mapping updated (AE role). Demo VM invite sent with credentials via secure DM. Added to #sales-demos. Assigned to rachel-ops-admin.

omar_ae: I got the demo VM DM and can log in to Salesforce. Thank you! Can @marta_cs schedule a shadow session this week?

marta_cs: Scheduled a 30-min shadow for Fri 10am PT. I'll DM the prep checklist and the demo script variations for infra vs hosted workflows. Welcome aboard! :tada:
